entries.title: Review capture comments alongside reading exceptions
entries.description: See the foreman's notes alongside captured hours and photo evidence to help resolve reading exceptions.

entries.title: Organise fleet categories by kind, icon and colour
entries.description: Create separate machine and implement categories, filter them by kind, and choose recognisable icons and colours. Categories no longer have a preset hourly rate field.

entries.title: Add implements with suggested codes
entries.description: Select an implement category to receive a suggested code based on its name and the next available number. Keep the suggestion or enter your own code before saving.

entries.title: See updates relevant to your business
entries.description: The Changelog now shows updates for the business you are using, with read status tracked separately for each business. Acknowledged updates stay dismissed when you switch away and back.

entries.title: Add context to hour readings
entries.description: Include an optional comment when capturing a reading to tell management about meter damage or anything else they should know.

entries.title: Check the minimum reading before saving
entries.description: The capture screen now shows the minimum allowed hours, including readings queued on your phone. Synced captures appear immediately in history, keeping the latest known value up to date.

entries.title: Recognise machines by category icons and colours
entries.description: Distinct category icons and colours now appear in the machine list, category filters and machine details.
